title.narrative: Lokaler till org. för mänskliga rättigheter

description.narrative: Contribution aims to provide some CSOs in Mozambique with opportunity to buy premises for their activities, for ex for office space or space for legal aid centers and similar. The support aims to increase democratic participation through CSO participation in society, which will be feasible to a greater degree if CSOs can use budget for other costs than rent, avoid eviction & increase sustainability of orgs/CS

Insatsens syfte är att ge några CSO i Mocambique möjlighet att köpa lokaler för sin verksamhet, t.ex. kontorslokaler men också lokaler till rättshjälps-centra och liknande. Stödet avser öka demokratiutövandet genom CSOs deltagande i samhället vilket möjliggörs till större grad när de kan använda sin budget till annat än hyra, inte hotas av vräkning, och ökar sin bärkraftighet /CS

The objective of this contribution was to provide a number of CSOs in Mozambique with an opportunity to purchase premises for their activities, for an example office space or space for legal aid centers. The idea was that through this support, the same CSOs could use budget for other costs than rent, avoid eviction and increase sustainability. Renting out of some extra office space would also provide some extra income.
The CSOs were beneficiaries under the AGIR programme, implemented by Diakonia, IBIS and Oxfam Novib. Diakonia was tasked with the responsibility to implement the project activity and the embassy was to approve (no objections) the purchases of the properties. Contracts were signed between the organisations and Diakonia, specifying the terms of the use of the premises. The premises were registered under the new owners, whom would receive full rights after five years.

By the end of the project period (March 2014) premises had been purchased to six local organisation involved in Human rights, democrazy and good governance; Liga dos Direitos Humanos (LDH), Parlamento Juvenil (PJ), FORCOM, UNAC, AKILIZETO and ACAMO. All houses were, at the time of the final report (March 2014), up to the standards required by the contract between the embassy and Diakonia.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
